decisions.reason: As an agency-focused compliance tool that stayed on its own page through 2024, it appears near the firm's strategic direction and likely good enough relative to aspiration levels to retain while moderate industry growth provides some slack.

Its continued placement on the home page suggests strong strategic importance and satisfactory market acceptance, so under behavioral-theory logic management has little reason to search for an alternative use of those resources.
This configurable managed hosting plan is close to the core business and remained actively presented in 2024, indicating results likely at or near aspiration with low pressure to discontinue.

Although newer and less prominently displayed, extended PHP security support fits the firm's hosting-security capabilities and compliance push, so with some organizational slack management is likely to keep it while performance becomes clearer.
